prereg.question: given the day's realised QQQUSDT move, how far is each system's stated book move from the book's realised move
prereg.event_rule: UTC daily QQQUSDT return <= -0.01, at least 60 prior days
prereg.stale_rule: days on which any instrument's close is unchanged are removed from every arm's daily history and from the events

primary.metric: mean absolute error of the book's daily move, percentage points
primary.test: Wilcoxon signed-rank over per-day mean errors

secondary: pinball loss at q = 0.1 for skfolio_vine and skfolio_ep
